diagnosis: In Gin, middleware registered via r.Use() only applies to routes registered AFTER the Use() call. The sensitive /wallet/payout handler is registered before r.Use(middleware.WalletAuthMiddleware()), leaving the endpoint completely unprotected. An unauthenticated attacker can initiate arbitrary payout disbursements from any wallet account ID.
